name: ChromeOS Flex 16733.48
notes: SHA-1 because that is the only digest Google publishes for recovery images, in the cloudready_recovery.json manifest the Chromebook Recovery Utility itself reads. It is weaker than this project would pin by choice and it is still the difference between 'this is the image Google built' and 'this is whatever answered the request'. Google publishes ChromeOS Flex for generic hardware, unlike ChromeOS proper, which is OEM-only. The media is a raw disk rather than an ISO - the recovery image boots into the ChromeOS Flex installer, which then installs onto the machine's own disk - which is why 'installer' and 'iso' had to stop being the same idea. UEFI is a requirement rather than a preference: ChromeOS Flex will not boot on a legacy BIOS. The download is 1.24 GB and expands to 8.9 GB.
